WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled
  FROM per_order
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_unfilled, p.avg_unfilled - o.avg_unfilled AS excess_overall
  FROM per_order AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE p.avg_unfilled > o.avg_unfilled
), group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled
  FROM above_overall
), selected AS (
  SELECT a.avg_unfilled,
         a.excess_overall,
         a.avg_unfilled - g.avg_unfilled AS excess_group
  FROM above_overall AS a
  CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
  WHERE a.avg_unfilled > g.avg_unfilled
)
SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled), AVG(excess_overall), AVG(excess_group)
FROM selected;

assumptions.assumption: The overall and group averages are unweighted averages across orders’ per-order averages; NULL remaincount values are ignored, while NULL ordersmark values form one group.
